title: World Cup Day 11: Japan beat Tunisia 4-0
excerpt: Group F action at Estadio BBVA in Monterrey on June 21.
body:
Day 11 of the 2026 FIFA World Cup delivered 1 match and 4 goals on Sunday, June 21. The tournament, spread across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, continued its group stage with action that will resonate in standings tables and living rooms alike — not least in the Indian-American households tuning in from cities that are, for once, hosting the spectacle rather than streaming it from half a world away.

Here is everything you need to know.

## Tunisia 0-4 Japan
*Group F · Estadio BBVA, Monterrey*

Japan produced the standout result of the day, hammering Tunisia 4-0 at Estadio BBVA. It was a masterclass from the opening minutes, with Japan pressing high, winning second balls, and punishing every defensive lapse. Tunisia looked shell-shocked by the intensity.

For Japan, this is as good a World Cup start as they could have scripted. For Tunisia, the question now is whether they can recover mentally — and on goal difference — in time for their remaining group fixtures.

## What It Means for the Standings

In Group F, **Japan** move to 3 points and put themselves in a strong position; **Tunisia** sit on zero points and will need results in their remaining fixtures. 

With 48 teams and a format that sends the top two from each group — plus the eight best third-placed sides — into the round of 32, the margins are tighter than they appear. Goal difference could prove decisive.

## What's Next

Day 12 (Monday, June 22) brings 4 more group stage matches:

- **Argentina vs Austria** — Group J at AT&T Stadium, Dallas
- **France vs Iraq** — Group I at Lincoln Financial Field, Philadelphia
- **Norway vs Senegal** — Group I at MetLife Stadium, New York/New Jersey
- **Jordan vs Algeria** — Group J at Levi's Stadium, San Francisco Bay Area
